copy_method: Byte-for-byte complete current final functional/source-notice sites and six current native opening JPEGs per case. No transformation; project guidance, raw reports, full/intermediate/state images and external reference captures excluded.

cases.runtime: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript; fictional book catalogue with browser-local variant bag, exact USD totals, automatic persistence, correction and current text export. No order, sending service, payment or backend.
cases.original_material: Six original fictional books, cover studies, six authored text samples, two original interior drawings, publisher identity and source. Photography titles contain labeled field notes without photographic plates.
cases.composition: Compared catalogue ledger, featured spread and shared shelf with fixed six books. Selected attached-caption shelf followed by complete catalogue; phone uses one featured book before the range.
cases.revision: Added substantial selected-title samples, meaningful phone cover facts, bag/sample routes and labeled add amount; corrected stale feedback, guide-link treatment and current book/format query persistence.
cases.state_contract: Each book/format pair has quantity 1–8 and integer-cent USD arithmetic. Successful bag changes persist automatically; invalid quantity preserves input and prior bag. Current book/format query survives reload, keeping hash and unrelated query values. Text export reads the current successful bag; Clear removes this example's selection and obsolete Add feedback.

cases.runtime: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript; three fictional sessions, exact overlap/chronological interval calculation, prepared itinerary, explicit local keep/recovery and current text export. No availability, booking, ticket or payment.
cases.original_material: Original fictional evening, venue, three sessions, record mark, page composition and source. One unchanged licensed Konstantin Aal concert photograph illustrates the scene.
cases.composition: Compared portrait/caption, separate image/copy and a shared black photographic poster. Selected useful facts in its negative space; phone composes the portrait, title and action as one scene. A practical running order follows.
cases.revision: Integrated hero type and facts within the photograph, quieted the empty result, added exact overlap cue and explicit time marker, cleared obsolete action feedback. Portable photo metadata identifies musician.jpg by basename.
cases.state_contract: At least one session; Deep Listening and Night Shift overlap 19:30–20:00 for 30 minutes and choices remain intact. Preparing snapshots compatible choices; later edits make it stale and block keep/export while retaining the earlier kept copy. Reload/recovery restores the valid saved version; export uses the current prepared result.

cases.runtime: Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript; exact local study week from goal, Monday date, weekdays, one repeated length and time, prepared/kept states and text/JSON exports. No calendar event, backend, account or sync.
cases.original_material: Original fictional utility identity, four-bar mark, sample study week, HTML agenda, English guide and source.
cases.composition: Compared compact statement over broad week, week-first and input-first. Selected a real five-day sample plan beneath a quiet statement; phone becomes a chronological readable agenda. The task uses input-first order.
cases.revision: Aligned phone empty-day dates, placed the repeated-time/length rule beside its fields, added a ruled guide comparison of current/prepared/kept work and preserved fixture-label gutter.
cases.state_contract: Build validates goal, real Monday date, selected weekdays, supported duration and 24-hour time. Each chosen day repeats one time and length with explicit next-day end dates when needed. Draft edits make the prepared plan stale and block keeping/export. Kept work stays separate; return restores it, reset clears the current result and retains kept work, and explicit forget removes it.

licensing: Original material retains the existing candidate licensing status; no new public redistribution rights. Third-party font and photograph notices remain applicable.
